# GetPhysicsAngularVelocityX <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetPhysicsAngularVelocityX:Float32 entity:Int32, global:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | The body. |
| `global` | In | Int32 | `0` | False (default): the numbers are in the space of the body. True: they are in the world. |

**Returns:** Meters per second, or degrees per second for turning.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

The x part of what `PhysicsAngularVelocity` sets.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
